description:
The image is titled "Diagram 3.1 Types of separating floor" and shows three cross-sections, labelled (a) Floor type 1, (b) Floor type 2, and (c) Floor type 3. The word "SECTION" appears in the bottom right corner.

In (a) Floor type 1, a "Soft covering" points down to a speckled layer above a thin line with three cross-hatched squares. Arrows and lines point to a "Ceiling" on the left and a "Concrete base" on the right.

In (b) Floor type 2, "Floating floor", "Floating layer", and "Resilient layer" point down to a stacked structure consisting of a speckled layer, a cross-hatched layer, and another speckled layer. Below are three cross-hatched squares. Arrows and lines point to a "Ceiling" on the left and a "Concrete base" on the right.

In (c) Floor type 3, the label "Platform floor" sits above a stacked structure of hatched layers, with "Floating layer" and "Resilient layer" pointing down to it. Below are vertical cross-hatched supports and a row of circles. Arrows and lines point to an "Independent ceiling" on the left and a "Timber frame base" on the right.
